problem.title: Your website is quietly costing you customers.
problem.lead: You built your site years ago. It worked. Then the web moved on — and yours didn't.
items: Takes 6+ seconds to load on mobile (53% of visitors leave before it finishes)
Looks like it was designed in 2015 — because it was
Ranks on page 4 of Google because Core Web Vitals are tanking
Runs on a CMS that costs €80–200/month to host, plugin, and patch
Has security holes you don't know about — until you're hacked
problem.outro: Every day this continues, you're losing leads to competitors with faster, cleaner sites. And the agency quotes? €8,000–€25,000 and three months of meetings.

solution.title: We rebuild your site. Better in every way that matters.
solution.lead: BetterSite takes your existing website and rebuilds it from scratch on modern foundations — keeping what works, fixing what doesn't, adding what's missing. You see the result before you commit.

features.title: Cheaper to Maintain
features.body: Forget €200/month hosting and plugin licenses. Most rebuilds run on €5–20/month. You keep the savings.

features.body: Less theater, more output. Your live preview lands in your inbox in two days — not two months.

items.q: Is the sample really free? What's the catch?
items.a: Genuinely free. No card, no contract. We rebuild your homepage and show you. If you don't continue, you owe nothing — we just keep the work as a portfolio piece.

items.q: How can you do this in 48 hours when agencies take months?
items.a: Most agencies bill discovery meetings, slide decks, and revisions. We use modern tooling to clone your structure, redesign the surface, and ship. Less theater, more output.

items.q: Will I lose my SEO rankings?
items.a: No. We preserve your URL structure, content, and metadata — and improve technical SEO on top. Most clients gain rankings within 30 days.
Hosting, security patches, uptime monitoring, content updates (within reason), and minor design tweaks. Flat monthly fee, cancel anytime. Detailed in the contract.

items.q: What if I want changes after seeing the sample?
items.a: That is the point of the sample. We discuss revisions in the contract phase, lock scope, and build the rest. No surprise invoices.
The free sample is your homepage — fastest way to show what we can do. The full rebuild covers your entire site.
Modern static-site stacks (Astro, Next.js) deployed on edge infrastructure. Translation: very fast, very cheap, very secure.

final.title: See your website, rebuilt — before you pay a cent.
